name: tdd
use_when: Implement behavior test-first at agreed public interfaces.
limits: Agree test seams first; the reviewed revision puts refactoring in review.
evidence_scope: One synthetic TDD task on 2026-10-30; this pinned revision only.
runtime_notes: No specific programming language required by the instruction file.

name: diagnosing-bugs
use_when: Investigate a difficult bug or performance regression with a repeatable feedback loop.
limits: Needs a reproducing environment and runnable checks; redact captured credentials.
evidence_scope: Exact instruction file reviewed; not locally executed.
runtime_notes: No specific programming language required by the instruction file.

name: spec-driven-development
use_when: Specify a larger or ambiguous change before planning and coding.
limits: Stops after the specification for human review; later phases and helper skills were not evaluated.
evidence_scope: Specification phase only, one synthetic task on 2026-10-30.
runtime_notes: No specific programming language required by the instruction file.

name: enterprise-architecture
use_when: Create architecture views, decision records or an enterprise model.
limits: Load the matching references; Claude Code is documented, other clients unverified here.
evidence_scope: Exact instruction file reviewed; not locally executed.
runtime_notes: Python for the optional consistency linter; this is not a Python-only architecture skill.

name: improve-codebase-architecture
use_when: Explore codebase friction and opportunities to deepen modules.
limits: User-invoked; requires helper skills and a fresh subagent; writes an HTML report with CDN assets and can update glossary/ADRs later.
evidence_scope: Main SKILL.md reviewed; helper chain not fully reviewed or executed.
runtime_notes: No specific programming language required by the instruction file.

name: research
use_when: Investigate a question using primary sources and produce cited findings.
limits: Requires a background agent and writes a Markdown findings file; use only when delegation and writes are authorized.
evidence_scope: Exact instruction file reviewed; not locally executed.
runtime_notes: No specific programming language required by the instruction file.

name: accessibility-audit
use_when: Review supplied web markup or visuals against a bounded accessibility checklist.
limits: Web-scoped; screenshots and markup do not establish full runtime or assistive-technology conformance.
evidence_scope: One static HTML fixture on 2026-10-30; no full conformance assessment.
runtime_notes: Accepts visual or markup evidence; language:any is not a claim of non-web accessibility support.

name: security-threat-model
use_when: Model repository-grounded assets, trust boundaries, abuse paths and mitigations.
limits: Explicit AppSec request; validate context with the user before the final report; not a runtime security audit.
evidence_scope: One synthetic threat-model task and follow-up on 2026-10-30.
runtime_notes: No specific programming language required by the instruction file.

name: agentic-readiness-assessment
use_when: Run a deliberate comprehensive repository-readiness assessment.
limits: Writes a report, runs checks and a reversible probe; reviewed version requires a commercial closing link.
evidence_scope: One synthetic repository on 2026-10-30; validator run separately by evaluator.
runtime_notes: Python report validator; project checks need the target project's runtimes.

name: retro
use_when: After session friction, identify improvements to navigation, checks, steering files or tools.
limits: Explicit user invocation; needs writing-for-agents and session evidence; recommendations do not authorize remediation.
evidence_scope: retro, writing-for-agents, README and license reviewed; no local execution.
runtime_notes: No specific programming language required by the instruction file.

name: OpenSpec
runtime_notes: Standalone CLI or package-manager installation; npm route needs Node.js >=22.12.0, not a JavaScript-only target project.
use_when: Use a change-centric SDD toolkit with proposals, specs, design, tasks and archival.
limits: Initialization/update writes agent/project files; command names vary by client; review documented usage telemetry.
evidence_scope: README and license reviewed; no local execution or comparative benchmark.

name: Spec Kit
runtime_notes: Specify CLI needs Python >=3.11 and uv in the reviewed setup; target application language is independent.
use_when: Use a maintained SDD toolkit with project principles, specification, plan, tasks and implementation/convergence.
limits: Initialization creates project/integration files; verify the selected agent integration and any community components.
evidence_scope: README and license reviewed; no local execution or comparative benchmark.
